messages:
Elena (CS): quick handoff for NimbusWorks trial — 30d pilot starts today. Needs: SAML SSO, VPC peering (customer CIDR 10.18.0.0/16), and reserved throughput for planned load tests (~320 rps). Decision review ~60d, high renewal upside if pilot stable.
Sam (Sales): noted. Contract: 30d pilot MSA, reserved slot + burst to 3 GPUs. Billing contact: accounting@nimbusworks.com.
Marta (Success Manager): I added 30/45/55d touch cadence in Gainsight and set health watch. Will track API success rate and 95p latency.
Ravi (Support): please paste SAML metadata and cert thumbprint; Ill open a priority ticket and tag infra.
Elena (CS): SAML xml in secure email, attaching to ticket. Peer CIDR = 10.18.0.0/16. They require allowlist egress to our regions only.
Ivy (Eng): OK. Two quick Qs: 1) Are we ok to use quantized-v2 for pilot? 2) Any private prompt repo to preload?
Sam (Sales): parity with hosted outputs required; no custom weights. Prompt templates = a few system prompts for triage workflows, will share. quantized-v2 is fine.
provision-bot: Ticket CS-7012 created by Ravi — "NimbusWorks pilot: SAML + VPC peering + reserved throughput". Assignees: @ivy_eng, @elena_cs. ETA for peering validation: 48h.
Ivy (Eng): Eng tasks: validate peering + run connectivity smoke tests, stage SAML on test IdP, allocate reserved slot and run quick sanity generate. Ill post the smoke test command and results.
Ravi (Support): added network checklist to CS-7012 and set priority: high. Please include traces for any calls >400ms.
Marta (Success Manager): Ill run a short survey after week-1 demo and feed into health score. Current renewal risk: medium (depends on pilot perf and network).
Elena (CS): owners recap: Ivy — eng; Ravi — support; Marta — health tracking; Sam — customer comms. Next steps: Ivy confirm peering details and smoke test; Ravi post ticket updates; Sam schedule week-1 demo. Tag #eng-oncall if peering fails blocking. Thanks!
